title: Manteca on I-5: Exit 461 (CA 120 East)
meta: Manteca sits off I-5 at exit 461, where Highway 120 leads east. See nearby exit 460 gas, Mossdale Crossing, and the closest rest areas.

faq.q: What exit is Manteca on I-5?
faq.a: Exit 461, signed CA 120 East; Manteca, Sonora. Highway 120 leads east from there to Manteca.

faq.q: Is there gas near Manteca on I-5?
faq.a: One gas station, an Arco, is listed at exit 460 in the map data. That is as mapped, not live, so it does not say whether it is open.

faq.q: Where does I-5 cross the San Joaquin River near Manteca?
faq.a: At Mossdale Crossing, near exit 460 on the left going north. The crossing is near a steel railroad lift bridge.

faq.q: Why is Manteca named after lard?
faq.a: Manteca is Spanish for lard, which is odd for a town whose railroad stop shipped dairy products. According to the I-5 Buddy landmark text, nobody agrees on how the name came about.

flags.text: and it is not affiliated with Caltrans or the CHP
flags.reason: The packet says nothing about any affiliation with Caltrans or the CHP.

flags.text: Going south, Westley Rest Area is about 16 miles back at mile 444.9
flags.reason: Going south, mile 444.9 is ahead of Manteca, not back. The packet gives only the distance, so 'back' misstates the relation.
